description: **A launch using proxy.file_rules gets no kit check.** harness/ctl.py:381 checks only `dev.file_rules` against the kit. Since 0.34.0 shipped rules live in proxy.file_rules, so that route has no guard. Check both keys, with a host test. Also: `value_problems` does not hold `proxy.dxvk_wndproc_fix` to its release value when a component sets it (J78 review finding 8; no component does today). Raised: J78 review round 1, 2026-11-06.
title: ctl.py guards only dev.file_rules against the kit
